description: This file implements factory classes and functions for creating SRS estimators, including generic and pooled variants, with dependencies on time alignment and sequence generator factories. It also provides functions to create these factories and a decorator for logging.

classes.name: srs_estimator_factory_generic
classes.description: Factory class for creating generic SRS estimators with specified dependencies.

classes.name: srs_estimator_factory_pool
classes.description: Factory class for creating pooled SRS estimators with thread management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new SRS estimator instance, decorated with logging.

methods.name: create_validator
methods.description: Creates a validator for SRS estimator configuration.
